authenticationSchemes.name: HTTP Basic
authenticationSchemes.description: Authentication scheme using the HTTP Basic Standard

authenticationSchemes.name: OAuth Bearer Token
authenticationSchemes.description: Authentication scheme using the OAuth Bearer Token Standard

authenticationSchemes.name: OAuth v2.0
authenticationSchemes.description: Authentication Scheme using the OAuth Standard

Resources.name: Role
Resources.description: Roles supported by the endpoint. These are used as a lookup catalog for managing the user roles attribute.

Resources.name: Entitlement
Resources.description: Entitlements supported by the endpoint. These are used as a lookup catalog for managing the user entitlements attribute.

attributes.name: userName
attributes.description: Unique identifier the user uses to sign in to the service provider. Each user MUST have a non-empty userName, unique across all users. If no other format is defined, use '<givenname>.<familyname>' in lowercase. Transliterate every character to plain ASCII a-z: remove accents and expand ligatures (æ -> ae, ø -> o, å -> a). Join name tokens with '.'. Example: 'Åse Kari Kjærøy' -> 'ase.kari.kjaeroy'.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The components of the user's real name.

subAttributes.name: formatted
subAttributes.description: The full name, including middle names, titles and suffixes, formatted for display. Optional; set only when known.

subAttributes.name: familyName
subAttributes.description: The family (last) name: the final token of the full name.

subAttributes.name: givenName
subAttributes.description: The given (first) name(s): all tokens of the full name except the last.

subAttributes.name: middleName
subAttributes.description: The middle name(s). Optional; set only when stated explicitly.

subAttributes.name: honorificPrefix
subAttributes.description: The honorific prefix (title), such as Mr. or Dr. Optional; set only when stated.

subAttributes.name: honorificSuffix
subAttributes.description: The honorific suffix, such as Jr. Optional; set only when stated.

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.description: The name of the user for display to end users, normally the full name.

attributes.name: nickName
attributes.description: The casual name of the user, if different from the given name. Optional; set only when known.

attributes.name: profileUrl
attributes.description: URL of the user's online profile page. Optional; set only when known.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The user's job title. Optional; set only when known.

attributes.name: userType
attributes.description: The relationship between the organization and the user, such as Employee or Contractor. Optional; set only when known.

attributes.name: preferredLanguage
attributes.description: The user's preferred written or spoken language (language tag). Optional; set only when known.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: The user's default location for localizing currency, dates and numbers (language tag). Optional; set only when known.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: The user's time zone in IANA (Olson) format. Optional; set only when known.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: The user's administrative status. true = enabled, false = disabled. New users are normally created with true.

attributes.name: password
attributes.description: The user's clear-text password, used to set an initial password or reset it. Never returned. Set only when a password is provided.

attributes.name: emails
attributes.description: Email addresses of the user. Optional; set only when an address is known. Never derive an address from the name or userName.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: Email address of the user, canonicalized to lowercase.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: A human-readable name, primarily used for display purposes. Optional.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: A label for the address's function: work, home or other.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: true for the preferred email address. At most one address may be primary.

attributes.name: phoneNumbers
attributes.description: Phone numbers of the user. Optional; set only when a number is known.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: Phone number of the user, as provided.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: A human-readable name, primarily used for display purposes. Optional.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: A label for the number's function: work, home, mobile, fax, pager or other.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: true for the preferred phone number. At most one number may be primary.

attributes.name: ims
attributes.description: Instant messaging addresses of the user. Optional; set only when known.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: Instant messaging address of the user, as provided.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: A human-readable name, primarily used for display purposes. Optional.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The messaging service: aim, gtalk, icq, xmpp, msn, skype, qq or yahoo.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: true for the preferred messaging address. At most one address may be primary.

attributes.name: photos
attributes.description: URLs of photos of the user. Optional; set only when known.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: URL of a photo of the user, as provided.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: A human-readable name, primarily used for display purposes. Optional.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The photo's function: photo or thumbnail.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: true for the preferred photo. At most one photo may be primary.

attributes.name: addresses
attributes.description: Physical mailing addresses of the user. Optional; set only the parts that are known.

subAttributes.name: formatted
subAttributes.description: The full mailing address, formatted for display or use with a mailing label. This attribute MAY contain newlines.

subAttributes.name: streetAddress
subAttributes.description: The full street address component, which may include house number, street name, PO BOX, and multi-line extended street address information. This attribute MAY contain newlines.

subAttributes.name: locality
subAttributes.description: The city or locality component.

subAttributes.name: region
subAttributes.description: The state or region component.

subAttributes.name: postalCode
subAttributes.description: The zipcode or postal code component.

subAttributes.name: country
subAttributes.description: The country name component.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: A label indicating the attribute's function; e.g., 'work', 'home' or 'other'.

attributes.name: groups
attributes.description: Groups the user belongs to, direct or indirect (nested or dynamic membership). Only direct membership can be added or removed.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The id of the group resource. Not the group name.

subAttributes.name: $ref
subAttributes.description: The URI of the corresponding Group resource to which the user belongs

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: A human readable name, primarily used for display purposes. READ-ONLY.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: A label indicating the attribute's function; e.g., 'direct' or 'indirect'.

attributes.name: entitlements
attributes.description: Entitlements assigned to the user.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The id of the entitlement, as listed by the service provider's entitlement catalog.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: The display name of the entitlement. Recommended when adding.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The entitlement type, as listed by the service provider's entitlement catalog.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: true for the preferred entitlement. At most one entitlement may be primary. Optional.

attributes.name: roles
attributes.description: Roles assigned to the user.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The id of the role, as listed by the service provider's role catalog.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: The display name of the role. Recommended when adding.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The role type, as listed by the service provider's role catalog.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: true for the preferred role. At most one role may be primary. Optional.

attributes.name: x509Certificates
attributes.description: Certificates issued to the user. Optional; set only when known.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The X.509 certificate, base64 encoded (DER), as provided.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: A human-readable name, primarily used for display purposes. Optional.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: A label for the certificate's function. Optional.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: true for the preferred certificate. At most one certificate may be primary.

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.description: The name of the group. REQUIRED.

attributes.name: members
attributes.description: Members of the group.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The id of the member resource (User or Group). Not a userName or display name.

subAttributes.name: $ref
subAttributes.description: The URI of the member resource. Set by the service provider.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The member resource type: User or Group.

attributes.name: employeeNumber
attributes.description: Identifier assigned to the person by the organization. Optional; set only when known.

attributes.name: costCenter
attributes.description: The name of the cost center. Optional; set only when known.

attributes.name: organization
attributes.description: The name of the organization. Optional; set only when known.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: The name of the division. Optional; set only when known.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The name of the department. Optional; set only when known.

attributes.name: manager
attributes.description: The user's manager, referencing the id of the manager's User resource.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The id of the manager's User resource. Not a userName or display name. Required when manager is set. Empty string clears the manager.

subAttributes.name: $ref
subAttributes.description: The URI of the manager's User resource. Set by the service provider.

subAttributes.name: displayName
subAttributes.description: The display name of the manager. Read-only.

Resources.name: Role
Resources.description: Endpoint role used for the user roles attribute

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the role.

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.description: A human-readable name for the role.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: A label indicating the role's function.

Resources.name: Entitlement
Resources.description: Endpoint entitlement used for the user entitlements attribute

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the entitlement.

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.description: A human-readable name for the entitlement.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: A label indicating the entitlement's function.

attributes.name: typeInfo
attributes.description: Specifies additional information about the specific type of the entitlement. subAttributes may vary depending on the type of the entitlement.

Resources.name: Service Provider Configuration
Resources.description: Schema for representing the service provider's configuration

attributes.name: documentationUri
attributes.description: An HTTP addressable URL pointing to the service provider's human consumable help documentation.

attributes.name: patch
attributes.description: A complex type that specifies PATCH configuration options.

subAttributes.name: supported
subAttributes.description: Boolean value specifying whether the operation is supported.

attributes.name: bulk
attributes.description: A complex type that specifies BULK configuration options.

subAttributes.name: supported
subAttributes.description: Boolean value specifying whether the operation is supported.

subAttributes.name: maxOperations
subAttributes.description: An integer value specifying the maximum number of operations.

subAttributes.name: maxPayloadSize
subAttributes.description: An integer value specifying the maximum payload size in bytes.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: A complex type that specifies FILTER options.

subAttributes.name: supported
subAttributes.description: Boolean value specifying whether the operation is supported.

subAttributes.name: maxResults
subAttributes.description: Integer value specifying the maximum number of resources returned in a response.

attributes.name: changePassword
attributes.description: A complex type that specifies change password options.

subAttributes.name: supported
subAttributes.description: Boolean value specifying whether the operation is supported.

attributes.name: sort
attributes.description: A complex type that specifies sort result options.

subAttributes.name: supported
subAttributes.description: Boolean value specifying whether the operation is supported.

attributes.name: authenticationSchemes
attributes.description: A complex type that specifies supported Authentication Scheme properties.

subAttributes.name: name
subAttributes.description: The common authentication scheme name; e.g., HTTP Basic.

subAttributes.name: description
subAttributes.description: A description of the authentication scheme.

subAttributes.name: specUri
subAttributes.description: An HTTP addressable URL pointing to the Authentication Scheme's specification.

subAttributes.name: documentationUri
subAttributes.description: An HTTP addressable URL pointing to the Authentication Scheme's usage documentation.

Resources.name: ResourceType
Resources.description: Specifies the schema that describes a SCIM Resource Type

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: The resource type's server unique id. May be the same as the 'name' attribute.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The resource type name. When applicable service providers MUST specify the name specified in the core schema specification; e.g., User

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The resource type's human readable description. When applicable service providers MUST specify the description specified in the core schema specification.

attributes.name: endpoint
attributes.description: The resource type's HTTP addressable endpoint relative to the Base URL; e.g., /Users

attributes.name: schema
attributes.description: The resource types primary/base schema URI

attributes.name: schemaExtensions
attributes.description: A list of URIs of the resource type's schema extensions

subAttributes.name: schema
subAttributes.description: The URI of a schema extension.

subAttributes.name: required
subAttributes.description: A Boolean value that specifies whether the schema extension is required for the resource type. If true, a resource of this type MUST include this schema extension and include any attributes declared as required in this schema extension. If false, a resource of this type MAY omit this schema extension.

Resources.name: Schema
Resources.description: Specifies the schema that describes a SCIM Schema

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: The unique URI of the schema. When applicable service providers MUST specify the URI specified in the core schema specification

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The schema's human readable name. When applicable service providers MUST specify the name specified in the core schema specification; e.g., User

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The schema's human readable description. When applicable service providers MUST specify the name specified in the core schema specification; e.g., User

attributes.name: attributes
attributes.description: A complex attribute that includes the attributes of a schema

subAttributes.name: name
subAttributes.description: The attribute's name

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The attribute's data type. Valid values include: 'string', 'complex', 'boolean', 'decimal', 'integer', 'dateTime', 'reference'.

subAttributes.name: multiValued
subAttributes.description: Boolean indicating an attribute's plurality.

subAttributes.name: description
subAttributes.description: A human readable description of the attribute.

subAttributes.name: required
subAttributes.description: A boolean indicating if the attribute is required.

subAttributes.name: canonicalValues
subAttributes.description: A collection of canonical values.  When applicable service providers MUST specify the canonical types specified in the core schema specification; e.g., 'work', 'home'.

subAttributes.name: caseExact
subAttributes.description: Indicates if a string attribute is case-sensitive.

subAttributes.name: mutability
subAttributes.description: Indicates if an attribute is modifiable.

subAttributes.name: returned
subAttributes.description: Indicates when an attribute is returned in a response (e.g., to a query).

subAttributes.name: uniqueness
subAttributes.description: Indicates how unique a value must be.

subAttributes.name: referenceTypes
subAttributes.description: Used only with an attribute of type 'reference'. Specifies a SCIM resourceType that a reference attribute MAY refer to. e.g., User

subAttributes.name: subAttributes
subAttributes.description: Used to define the sub-attributes of a complex attribute

subAttributes.name: name
subAttributes.description: The attribute's name

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The attribute's data type. Valid values include: 'string', 'complex', 'boolean', 'decimal', 'integer', 'dateTime', 'reference'.

subAttributes.name: multiValued
subAttributes.description: Boolean indicating an attribute's plurality.

subAttributes.name: description
subAttributes.description: A human readable description of the attribute.

subAttributes.name: required
subAttributes.description: A boolean indicating if the attribute is required.

subAttributes.name: canonicalValues
subAttributes.description: A collection of canonical values.  When applicable service providers MUST specify the canonical types specified in the core schema specification; e.g., 'work', 'home'.

subAttributes.name: caseExact
subAttributes.description: Indicates if a string attribute is case-sensitive.

subAttributes.name: mutability
subAttributes.description: Indicates if an attribute is modifiable.

subAttributes.name: returned
subAttributes.description: Indicates when an attribute is returned in a response (e.g., to a query).

subAttributes.name: uniqueness
subAttributes.description: Indicates how unique a value must be.

subAttributes.name: referenceTypes
subAttributes.description: Used only with an attribute of type 'reference'. Specifies a SCIM resourceType that a reference attribute MAY refer to. e.g., 'User'
